historical_map_source: CSV File Name and Leaf # columns, converted from author Excel workbooks; not a newly inferred filename counter.

visual_review.coverage: 18 supplied leaf groups, four views per group; metadata-sampled contact sheets only.
visual_review.finding: Reviewed groups show compatible within-leaf shape, venation and markings across different orientations/lighting. No obvious group contradiction in these sheets.
visual_review.limit: Not full 538-leaf visual adjudication, plant identity verification, field collection, or pathological diagnosis.

interpretation: Author-provided leaf identity in a separately acquired controlled archive, suitable for bounded cross-task computation. It does not supply onion plant identities or a new onion field cohort.
